classification: TDD construction; excluded from one-shot candidate/auditor allocation
environment: WSL Ubuntu Python 3.12.3; Xvfb 21.x; python-xlib real connection; no Docker

construction_attempts.detail: Xvfb did not allocate a display within 5s; shared /tmp/.X11-unix mode was not 1777 and display :100 was already owned by another process. No existing display was contacted.
Xvfb reported /tmp/.X11-unix permission mode failure and failed to bind its Unix socket. The shared directory and other X server were not changed.

construction_attempts.source: T2 instrumented owner before T3 normalization
construction_attempts.failure: six witnesses were present, but all key_down fields were null because Python-Xlib returns a list of 32 integers, not bytes

construction_attempts.source: T3 isolated owner copy converting a valid 32-integer Xlib bitmap to bytes
raw-only audit_payload plus literal synthetic positive and mutation cases
construction_attempts.tests: 3/3 including bitmap-bit and cross-occurrence release mutations

isolation: An unprivileged user+mount namespace with private tmpfs /tmp and private Unix X socket directory allowed Xvfb to start without changing shared /tmp or using another display.
